In this paper, we present a simple yet effective framework to unify the voxel-based representation with transformer, called UVTR.
In this paper, we represent image features in an explicit voxel space to alleviate the semantic ambiguity and facilitate further feature interactions, as depicted in Figure 1d.

experiments.summary: The proposed method achieves leading performance in the nuScenes test set for both object detection and the following object tracking task. For detection, it achieves 69.7%, 55.1%, and 71.1% NDS on nuScenes test set with point clouds, images, and multi-modality inputs,

evidence.quote: The proposed method achieves leading performance in the nuScenes test set for both object detection and the following object tracking task.
For detection, it achieves 69.7%, 55.1%, and 71.1% NDS on nuScenes test set with point clouds, images, and multi-modality inputs, respectively.

But we still preserve the 3D space VP without height compression for convenient cross-modality interaction in Section 3.2 and fine-grained object interaction in Section 3.3.
Overall, for both of them, 3D spatial interaction still plays a vital role and improves 2.6% and 0.6% NDS over 2D convolution for the camera- and LiDAR-based methods, respectively.
